answer: Require every agent to post a 400 POA bond locked 90 days, 100% slashed on proven duplication. Each attestation inherits a grading duty: one grading seat owed per ten attestations, and graders never review identities sharing a funding source, so a clone army vouching for its own kin gets flagged. New identities start at zero influence, so a gale of fresh accounts carries no weight until each has graded honestly; one ember cannot light a fake cluster, and the signal of duplication is public, auditable in seconds. 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 POA locked plus 100 grading seats owed.
